description: Imitation of the World Bank Atlas of Sustainable Development Goals 2023 chart 'Tuberculosis detection rates plummeted during the pandemic' (https://datatopics.worldbank.org/sdgatlas). Data: World Health Organization, retrieved from World Development Indicators (SH.TBS.DTEC.ZS). Hovering the line chart updates the bar chart to show that year's detection rates.

axis.labelExpr: {"ECS":"Europe & Central Asia","MEA":"Middle East & North Africa","NAC":"North America","LCN":"Latin America & Caribbean","SAS":"South Asia","SSF":"Sub-Saharan Africa","EAS":"East Asia & Pacific"}[datum.label]
